title: Storage Bundle Discount on Parking Licenses — Desk Guidance and Discount Credit
content:
While the lease also holds a storage rental in active status, each Covered Carport Space, Structured Garage Space, EV Charging Reserved Space and Private Detached Garage license of the lease receives a storage bundle discount credit against its monthly fee line at the rate this storage bundle program sets; the discount applies to monthly fees only and never to EV charging, fines or service fees.

## Scope of the program

- **Who qualifies.** A Parking License of one of the four products named above, on a lease that also holds a Storage Rental in active status.
- **What is discounted.** The monthly fee line of the Parking License — never EV charging, fines or service fees.
- **How it is booked.** As a storage bundle discount credit on the license's parking ledger, pointing at the monthly fee line it discounts.
- **Other discounts.** The storage bundle discount does not stack with any other parking discount, and no credit is posted against the fee line of a month in which the storage rental was not active on the fee charge day.

## The discount credit tool

**Capability.** `credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6` posts a storage bundle discount credit against one monthly license fee line of a parking license. One bundle discount credit is added to the license's parking ledger for exactly the amount given, pointing at the monthly fee line it discounts, dated today and belonging to the current billing month, and the license's outstanding parking balance goes down by the same amount. The fee line itself stays unchanged; the resident sees the discount next to that month's fee on the parking statement.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `parking_license_id` | the reference number of the resident's parking license whose ledger receives the discount, as returned by the parking license lookup | identifier |
| `source_parking_charge_id` | the reference number of the monthly license fee line being discounted, as returned for that line by the parking charges lookup | identifier |
| `discount_amount` | the discount credited against the fee line, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent when the credit is posted |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (the reference number of the new discount line), `parking_license_id` (the license credited), `source_parking_charge_id` (the monthly fee line the discount points at), `charge_code` (always `bundle_discount`), `discount_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the discount credited), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's posting date) and `resulting_parking_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the license's outstanding parking balance including this discount). A receipt carrying `credit_id` means the discount is on the ledger.

## Contract questions

**Does the fee line change?** No; the discount is a separate line next to that month's fee.

**What date does the discount carry?** Today's date, in the current billing month.
